title: 3D Texture
summary: Official Derivative texturing page for 3D Textures, covering normalized u/v/w sampling, layer blending, first-slice center coordinates, 2025.30000+ all-slice TOP processing, Texture 3D TOP POffset handling, and Time Machine TOP consumption.
guidance: Use this article when a plan needs continuous sampling through a stack of texture slices or a 3D volume-like TOP.
Remember that W coordinates are normalized; W=0 is not the first slice center, so use 0.5 / NumberOfSlices for the first slice.
Expect a 3D Texture to blend between neighboring slices when W falls between layers.
In 2025.30000+ builds, many TOP operations can apply to all slices of a 3D Texture.
Preserve Texture 3D TOP offset information when materials or Time Machine TOP need newest-slice behavior; downstream TOP processing can lose POffset metadata.
